column1: # Contributor mappings that cannot live in contributors/emails/.
# Two commit-author emails differing only in case (e.g. the same Mac reporting
# its hostname as both "Foo-Mac-mini.local" and "foo-Mac-mini.local") would
# need two filenames differing only in case. Git can track those, but NTFS and
# APFS cannot materialize both, so a clone on Windows/macOS prints
#   warning: the following paths have collided ...
# and leaves one entry permanently "modified" in git status. Entries that would
# collide live here instead, keyed by the exact email.
# Format: <exact commit-author email><TAB><github-login>. "#" starts a comment.
# Everything else still goes in contributors/emails/<email> — see README.md.
